newsitem.title: USA: SBC Warburg North America CEO retires.
newsitem.headline: SBC Warburg North America CEO retires.

text.p: Swiss Bank Corp investment banking unit SBC Warburg said John Dugan retired as chief executive of its North America operations, effective April 1.

SBC Warburg said managing director Andy Siciliano has relocated from London to New York to head a new American Business Development Committee. Warburg said Siciliano will be its most senior representative in the region.
The company said it named Simon Canning president and chief operating officer of the Americas. Canning will report directly to Hans de Gier, chairman of SBC Warburg.
Warburg also named Karlheinz Muhr head of corporate finance for the Americas.
